question: Does the refined temporal-covector perturbation dictionary from C10.48 remove the legacy translated RT Hamiltonian/00 mismatch on the pinned upstream model=2 and historical production RTK histories, without changing either solver or fitting any equation coefficient?
important_property: R00_corr uses only directly exported algebraic fields and contains no reconstructed Psi derivative.

decision_rules.closure: Classify corrected closure if, in both trees and at both binding epochs, median |R00_corr|/median |R00_old| <= 0.10 and median |R00_corr| <= 5e-11.
decision_rules.no_closure: Classify no closure if, in both trees and at both binding epochs, median |R00_corr|/median |R00_old| >= 0.50.
decision_rules.mixed: Otherwise classify mixed/inconclusive and preserve every epoch/k diagnostic.
decision_rules.nonfinite: Any non-finite required value blocks physical interpretation and receives the dedicated numerical-invalid classification.

guards: No physical or translation coefficient may be fitted after seeing the result.
Do not modify historical production dynamics or upstream model=2 equations.
Do not delete or relabel the old C10.37/C10.38/C10.42/C10.44/C10.46 results; this is a new translation gate.
A closure is a historical RT-fork convention/constraint result, not a completed-U1 cosmology certificate.
A no-closure result does not by itself prove published RT inconsistent.
